description: #433 Fast: the public MapView on flatRuntime="maps", controlled from React state, flying with animated flyTo between European cities and across the antimeridian over 2,000 points and a static GeoJSON region grid, with superseding commands, a pointer interruption, a mid-flight resize, instant jumps and mid-flight unmounts (e2e/fixtures/camera-transition-journey.tsx).

fixture.build: vite production build of the fixture with the built dist/wasm package

operations: navigate until the Map View is presented
fly Paris z7 -> Berlin z9 bearing 40
fly to Berlin, Vienna and Rome, each superseded after 8 presented frames
press the pointer after 8 presented frames
fly to Berlin, narrowing the Map View to 1,000 px after 3 frames
10 animate:false jumps between Berlin and Paris
3 cycles: fly to Berlin, Rome, then Vienna, unmount after 8 presented frames, remount
